topic.readerProblem: A marketer or agency person weighing AEOeye against Goodie wants to know which tool fits their job, what Goodie really costs now, which engines each covers, and where Goodie is the better pick.
topic.connection: AEOeye runs one-time AI visibility audits (free ChatGPT check, $29 five-engine report) for the same buyer questions Goodie tracks daily on a subscription; the page explains the difference honestly and recommends Goodie where ongoing tracking and attribution are the real need.

assessment: The page is based on Goodie's own pricing page, feature pages and service agreement read on 2026-10-03 and says near the top that we did not use the product hands-on. It replaces the earlier version's stale claims (an Explorer plan with three engines, a 30-day money-back guarantee, 'quote-only above $399', setup-heavy onboarding, a 'multi-engine' free AEOeye audit) with figures read from the rendered pricing page (annual $399 / monthly $478.80 via the page's own data attributes) and from the service agreement. It uses SparkToro's run-to-run variance research to explain why daily sampling is Goodie's structural advantage, flags where Goodie's own pages disagree (Claude on the monitoring page vs Enterprise-only in the pricing table; 13 vs 12 models), and states the limits of a ten-question AEOeye report. It deliberately does not rate the accuracy of Goodie's data, claim hands-on testing, repeat reviewer hearsay, verify Goodie's projected 15-40% citation lift, or promise that either tool improves visibility.

sources.supports: Rendered in a browser: Core $399, Pro $999, Agency Growth $275 on the default annual toggle; data attributes show $478.80, $1,198.80 and $330 for the other billing option; Core 5 engines (ChatGPT, AI Overview, Perplexity, AI Mode, Copilot), Pro adds Gemini, Alexa, Sparky, Enterprise adds Claude, Meta, DeepSeek, Grok (card says up to 13, FAQ says 12); prompts 120/250/500+; 1 brand; 5 seats on Core; daily data collection; export from Pro, API on Enterprise only; MCP on brand plans; Core 7-day free trial and self-serve start; Agency Growth 10 pitch workspaces, client workspaces from $399/mo.

Fees non-refundable, payments non-refundable regardless of usage, subscriptions auto-renew for equal terms, monthly plans cancel at end of cycle, 30 days' written notice for other terms, trials provided as-is.
Tracks brand mentions, ranking position, sentiment and share of voice; 'tracked daily'; model list includes Claude.
Actions for owned content, earned media, technical and social; execution in the platform; projected 15-40% citation lift (vendor projection).
Google Analytics integration identifies AI visits and traces them through conversion funnel to CRM data and revenue; attributed vs influenced revenue.

600 volunteers, 12 prompts, ChatGPT, Claude and Google's AI, 2,961 runs; under 1 in 100 chance ChatGPT or Google's AI repeats the same brand list; ask at least 60-100 times and average; work done with a Gumshoe.ai employee.
Definition of GEO/AEO as improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems.
MCP is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems.
